security_audit.summary: The high entropy finding is a false positive caused by readable Markdown content with Japanese text. Six findings are confirmed because the skill instructs agents to run repository-controlled Gradle, pnpm, and npx commands; the remaining backtick findings are Markdown fences or inline file paths.

remediation.issue: Repository-controlled build and test commands are run from the skill workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running ./gradlew, pnpm run, or npx commands, and show the exact command first.

remediation.issue: npx may execute a project or package binary during type checking.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a pinned local command such as pnpm exec tsc --noEmit, and document that package installation must not occur automatically.

remediation.issue: The skill does not state a trust boundary for untrusted repositories.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to avoid running build, lint, or test scripts in untrusted workspaces unless the user has reviewed the project scripts.

content.value_statement: Developers need quick feedback before committing code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through targeted lint, test, compile, and type checks.
actual_capabilities: Checks changed files with git status and staged file listings.
Guides backend lint checks with Checkstyle and SpotBugs tasks.
Runs focused backend tests when test execution is enabled.
Checks frontend lint, changed tests, and TypeScript types.
Produces a pass or fail report with next steps.
limitations: It is lighter than a full pull request quality gate.
It does not enforce code coverage thresholds.
It assumes Gradle, pnpm, and TypeScript tooling already exist.
It may skip tests when the user selects that mode.

use_cases.title: Check a feature branch before commit
use_cases.description: Run fast lint, focused tests, compilation, and type checks before creating a commit.

use_cases.title: Review staged changes quickly
use_cases.description: Inspect staged files and run the relevant backend or frontend checks for those changes.

use_cases.title: Validate a mixed stack update
use_cases.description: Check backend Gradle tasks and frontend pnpm tasks in one pre-commit workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Basic pre-commit check
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the pre-commit check for my current changes and summarize whether I can commit.

prompt_templates.title: Check staged files only
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused check before committing staged work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my staged files and run only the relevant pre-commit checks for those files.

prompt_templates.title: Skip tests for urgent change
prompt_templates.scenario: Urgent workflow that still needs lint and compile feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the pre-commit check with tests skipped. Explain what still needs testing later.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose failed checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the pre-commit check, group any failures by backend or frontend, and suggest the smallest next fix.

output_examples.input: Run a default pre-commit check for current changes.
output_examples.output: The report lists backend lint, tests, compilation, frontend lint, tests, and type checks with pass or fail status.
The report focuses on frontend lint, changed tests, and TypeScript checks, then states whether the staged changes are commit-ready.

output_examples.input: Run checks without tests for an urgent fix.
output_examples.output: The report covers lint, compile, and type status, and clearly notes that skipped tests must run later.

best_practices: Run this skill before each commit, then run the full QA workflow before opening a pull request.
Keep tests enabled for normal changes, and skip them only for urgent exceptions.
Review command output carefully before accepting a commit-ready result.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this skill as a full release or pull request quality gate.
Do not skip tests for routine development work.
Do not run repository scripts in an untrusted workspace without reviewing them first.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks changed files, backend lint and compile tasks, focused tests, frontend lint, changed tests, and TypeScript types.

faq.question: Is this the same as a full QA check?
faq.answer: No. It is a faster pre-commit workflow and does not replace the full QA process before a pull request.

faq.question: Can it skip tests?
faq.answer: Yes. The source guidance allows skipped tests for urgent cases, but recommends running tests later.

faq.question: Does it check code coverage?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that coverage checks are outside this lightweight workflow.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects Git, Bash, Gradle tasks, pnpm scripts, and TypeScript tooling in the target project.

faq.question: Can it run on backend and frontend changes together?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes separate backend and frontend phases for mixed changes.
